_: The source under .moon-data-cache/ that tools/gen-seawind.mjs reads, with the SHA-256 the shipped sea wind map was baked from. The bake refuses a file whose digest or size differs: a re-downloaded product that changed upstream would otherwise re-bake the map silently. Update the digest only together with the map baked from it (under a new name). Read with h5wasm 0.10.3 and written with sharp 0.35.4, both installed for the run: `npm i --no-save sharp@0.35.4 h5wasm@0.10.3`.
